Method of Attack: Sending users' browsing histories and tab URLs to remote servers
Remote code execution (RCE) functionality via responses from remote servers
Code obfuscation mixing legitimate functionality with malicious code
Subtle data exfiltration and potential for executing remote code
Discoverer: Rob Wu, Mozilla Browser Engineer and Add-on reviewer
Impacted Systems: Mozilla Firefox browsers with the add-ons installed
Attack Vector: Malicious Firefox add-ons installed from addons.mozilla.org (AMO)
